title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
abstract: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation. Existing methods preserve user intent and improve overall visual appeal, with less explicit emphasis on fine-grained design dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce Qwen-Image-PE, which learns visual design through two-stage training. Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) uses dense captions of well-designed images as design supervision. Reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) jointly compares all candidate images for the same request to refine lighting, composition, layout, and detail. On Qwen-Image-Bench with Qwen-Image-2.1, Qwen-Image-PE-397B improves over original requests by 7.81 points, while Qwen-Image-PE-9B outperforms all evaluated PE baselines. Further evaluations show gains in visual design, aesthetics, image quality, and human preference. We find that PE scales along three axes: training data, model size, and information density, with sufficient information density as a prerequisite for effective enhancement. Moreover, we demonstrate that Qwen-Image-PE generalizes to four additional T2I backbones, even surpassing native prompt enhancers on HunyuanImage-2.1 and FLUX 3 Image Klein. We release Qwen-Image-PE-9B at https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I.

summary.title_zh: Qwen-Image-PE：面向文生图提示增强的视觉设计学习
summary.core_contribution: 提出Qwen-Image-PE，通过两阶段训练让提示增强模型显式学习细粒度视觉设计维度，将欠明确的用户请求转化为连贯的视觉规格，从而提升文生图生成效果。
summary.method: 采用两阶段训练：第一阶段使用基于描述的反向蒸馏（CRD），以设计良好图像的密集描述作为设计监督进行监督微调；第二阶段使用组内设计奖励（GDR）的强化学习，对同一请求的所有候选图像进行联合比较，以优化光照、构图、布局和细节。
summary.findings: 在Qwen-Image-Bench上，Qwen-Image-PE-397B较原始请求提升7.81分，Qwen-Image-PE-9B优于所有评估的PE基线；在视觉设计、美学、图像质量和人类偏好上均有提升。研究发现PE沿训练数据、模型规模和信息密度三个轴扩展，且足够的信息密度是有效增强的前提；此外该模型可泛化到四个额外T2I骨干网络，在HunyuanImage-2.1和FLUX 3 Image Klein上甚至超越原生提示增强器。

title: Timing Matters Twice: When to Query and When to Skip in Flow-Matching On-Policy Distillation
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables flow-matching models to acquire complementary capabilities from specialized teachers through supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, different evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics and OCR accuracy, and different tasks, such as image generation and editing, emphasize different aspects of the denoising process, suggesting that their effective supervision may occur at different stages. Existing methods typically select supervision states from predefined timestep distributions, which may overlook these phase-dependent differences and incur unnecessary computational overhead. This motivates two critical timing decisions: when to adaptively query teachers for effective supervision based on the evolving generative process, and when to skip the remaining rollout to avoid redundant computation. In this paper, we introduce PhaseOPD, a phase-aware query-and-skip framework that identifies generative phases online from revisions of predicted-clean latents, using existing student velocity predictions without additional model evaluations. For each task-assigned teacher, PhaseOPD selects a supervision state based on its phase preference and skips the unused rollout suffix once all query decisions are finalized, preserving the single-query velocity-distillation objective. On SD3.5-M, PhaseOPD executes only 5.56 of 16 rollout positions per local batch, reducing training time by 41.3% relative to DanceOPD while improving Aesthetic, GenEval, and OCR scores.

summary.title_zh: 时机至关重要：流匹配在线策略蒸馏中何时查询与何时跳过
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出PhaseOPD框架，通过在线识别生成阶段来自适应决定何时查询教师模型进行监督以及何时跳过剩余轨迹以节省计算，在保持单次查询速度蒸馏目标的同时显著提升训练效率与生成质量。
summary.method: PhaseOPD利用学生模型已有的速度预测，从预测干净潜变量的修正中在线识别生成阶段，无需额外模型评估。针对每个任务分配的教师模型，根据其阶段偏好选择监督状态，并在所有查询决策确定后跳过未使用的轨迹后缀。该方法保持了单次查询速度蒸馏目标，避免了预定义时间步分布带来的阶段差异忽视和计算浪费。
summary.findings: 在SD3.5-M上，PhaseOPD每个本地批次仅执行16个展开位置中的5.56个，相比DanceOPD减少41.3%的训练时间，同时提升了Aesthetic、GenEval和OCR分数。

title: UltraFlash: Accelerating Megapixel Visual Synthesis
abstract: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.

summary.title_zh: UltraFlash：加速百万像素级视觉合成
summary.core_contribution: 论文识别出级联式潜在扩散模型在百万像素视觉合成中被忽视的瓶颈——VAE相关的像素空间转换操作，并提出UltraFlash方法显著加速这些操作，在提升图像质量的同时将4K生成延迟降低约2倍。
summary.method: UltraFlash包含两个组件：Latent Hyperloop用学习到的潜在空间捷径替代中间RGB往返转换，近似解码-缩放-编码变换而无需重复VAE编解码；Sparse Patch-based Decoding通过解决GroupNorm统计不一致导致的拼接缝问题并跨块复用缓存统计量，实现更小重叠的稀疏VAE解码以加速最终重建。该方法集成到先进的级联基线中。
summary.findings: 集成UltraFlash后，4K生成延迟降低约2倍，同时图像质量得到提升。结果表明优化像素空间转换可同时改善效率与保真度，为快速高质量的百万像素视觉合成提供了有效路径。

title: ToDoPro: Faster and Better Reference-Based Generation: Early Token Reduction via Downsampled Self-Probing
abstract: Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro). By executing a few denoising steps on spatially $2\times$ downsampled reference images, this cheap probing stage utilizes the DiT model itself to effectively and efficiently extract reference token importance. Using the probed importance, we apply a hierarchical reduction before the main denoising stage: we completely discard low-importance tokens, substitute mid-importance tokens with their downsampled counterparts to cheaply preserve global context, and keep high-importance tokens. Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks demonstrate that our early reduction accelerates inference significantly and mitigates peak GPU memory. Furthermore, we can improve generation quality by safely filtering out noisy, uninformative reference tokens, enabling the model to concentrate its limited attention capacity on genuinely useful tokens. The code will be released at https://github.com/scy639/ToDoPro

summary.title_zh: ToDoPro：更快更好的参考图像生成：通过下采样自探测实现早期令牌缩减
summary.core_contribution: 提出ToDoPro方法，在不引入额外参数且兼容模型内加速技术的前提下，通过早期令牌缩减实现参考图像生成加速并降低峰值显存，同时提升生成质量。
summary.method: 先对参考图像进行空间2倍下采样并执行少量去噪步骤，利用DiT模型自身高效探测参考令牌的重要性；然后根据探测到的重要性进行分层缩减：完全丢弃低重要性令牌，用下采样对应令牌替代中等重要性令牌以低成本保留全局上下文，保留高重要性令牌；最后在主去噪阶段前完成缩减。
summary.findings: 在三个基础模型和两个基准上的实验表明，早期缩减显著加速推理并降低峰值GPU显存；同时通过安全过滤噪声、无信息参考令牌，使模型将有限注意力集中于真正有用的令牌，从而提升生成质量。

title: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
abstract: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

summary.title_zh: 以复制为防御：通过诱导模型复制来保护图像免遭编辑
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出了一种名为Copying-as-Defense（CaD）的主动防御方法，通过诱导基于扩散变换器（DiT）的图像编辑器复制受保护图像而非执行编辑指令，从而有效阻止恶意或未经同意的图像篡改。
summary.method: 现有防御方法试图让模型减少对受保护参考图像的关注，但模型仍可依据文本指令和自身生成的token完成编辑。作者反其道而行之，通过受控注意力干预发现，仅在少数早期Transformer块中将目标token的注意力集中于参考图像，即可使编辑行为崩溃，令模型复现输入图像而非执行变换。基于此，CaD在早期Transformer块中最大化每个目标token对参考图像的注意力质量，由于注意力行经过归一化，增加对参考图像的注意力会自然抑制分配给文本和生成画布的注意力；同时将优化目标限制在早期块还可截断反向传播路径，降低优化成本。
summary.findings: 在多种编辑器和基准测试上，CaD将平均编辑成功率从无保护图像的81.4%降至24.0%（相对降低70.6%），相比最强基线DeContext（43.0%）进一步相对降低44.3%；此外，CaD每步优化速度比同类方法快约1.8至2.0倍。
